description: Show the backend label (cp_backend_label) in the home screen composer foot across models.coax, conversation.coax, and composer/models checks.

steps.send: In OpenAgents Desktop (`apps/openagents-desktop/page/models.coax`, `apps/openagents-desktop/page/layout/conversation.coax`, `apps/openagents-desktop/page/checks/composer-checks.coax`, and `apps/openagents-desktop/page/checks/models-checks.coax`): add `cp_backend_label` in `models.coax` returning `"Antigravity CLI"`, `"Psionic Metal"`, `"OpenRouter"`, `"Vertex AI"`, or `"Gemini API"` (or `""` with no model), and show it in the composer foot on the home screen instead of cost. Update the composer and model checks and verify with `coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only model`.

graders.run: grep -q 'cp_backend_label' apps/openagents-desktop/page/models.coax && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only model
